Council Meeting Minutes & Business Papers

Ordinary Council meetings are held on the fourth Thursday of each month, and members of the public are welcome to attend.

Business Papers outlining the matters to be considered, along with the official Minutes of each meeting, are available for viewing at the Council Chambers and the Library. These documents can also be accessed and downloaded below.

All Council meetings are recorded, with video recordings available to view below.

Business Papers will be published on this website as soon as they are available prior to each meeting. Minutes will be published as soon as they are available following each meeting.

As of February 2026 Council Meetings are live streamed and can be viewed on the Bogan Shire Council  YouTube Page.
